name: MemeMatch
description: We introduce MemeMatch, a large-scale multimodal meme dataset and retrieval system that bridges meme collection, annotation, and analysis in a unified pipeline. The dataset contains nearly one million image-with-text memes from Reddit’s r/Memes (2018–2023) and ImgFlip, with rich metadata. Each meme is decomposed into two semantic contexts: local context, capturing the editable text payload (overlay text and title), and global context, capturing the underlying visual substrate or template semantics.
